effects.effect: Your unique physiology enhances your movement. You gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) that use the [Climb](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.exploration/climb), [Gymnastics](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.exploration/gymnastics), or [Swim](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.exploration/swim) skills when you can use all your arms in the attempt.
